scope: Independent direct source JAR versus target resource comparison; no file writes, build or game launch by provider
aggregate_algorithm: Sort by project-relative path; each line sha256 + two spaces + path + LF; hash UTF-8 bytes with SHA256

allowed_conversions: UniformInt legacy value object flattened at provider dispatch level

nbt.kiosk_spawn_type: Both forge:spawn_type removal and neoforge:spawn_type addition explicitly present in schema group; value retained
nbt.reference_conversion_note: Eight complete typed trees equal previous converter output. kiosk additionally converts spawn_type to NeoForge. snowtower deliberately uses actual stored_enchantments component where legacy converter would leave inert custom_data.

limits: Static resource and schema comparison only; no runtime Codec decoding, generation, entity behavior, inventory opening, rendering or game validation. Unified build waits for both lanes to stop.
